verses.ar: يَا ٱبْنِي، أَصْغِ إِلَى حِكْمَتِي. أَمِلْ أُذُنَكَ إِلَى فَهْمِي،
verses.kjv: My son, attend unto my wisdom, [and] bow thine ear to my understanding:
verses.web: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
verses.he: בְּ֭נִי לְחָכְמָתִ֣י הַקְשִׁ֑יבָה לִ֝תְבוּנָתִ֗י הַט־אָזְנֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: لِحِفْظِ ٱلتَّدَابِيرِ، وَلْتَحْفَظَ شَفَتَاكَ مَعْرِفَةً.
verses.kjv: That thou mayest regard discretion, and [that] thy lips may keep knowledge.
verses.web: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.
verses.he: לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מְזִמֹּ֑ות וְ֝דַ֗עַת שְׂפָתֶ֥יךָ יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ شَفَتَيِ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ ٱلْأَجْنَبِيَّةِ تَقْطُرَانِ عَسَلًا، وَحَنَكُهَا أَنْعَمُ مِنَ ٱلزَّيْتِ،
verses.kjv: ¶ For the lips of a strange woman drop [as] an honeycomb, and her mouth [is] smoother than oil:
verses.web: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
verses.he: כִּ֤י נֹ֣פֶת תִּ֭טֹּפְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֣י זָרָ֑ה וְחָלָ֖ק מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן חִכָּֽהּ׃

verses.ar: لَكِنَّ عَاقِبَتَهَا مُرَّةٌ كَٱلْأَفْسَنْتِينِ، حَادَّةٌ كَسَيْفٍ ذِي حَدَّيْنِ.
verses.kjv: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.
verses.web: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
verses.he: וְֽ֭אַחֲרִיתָהּ מָרָ֣ה כַֽלַּעֲנָ֑ה חַ֝דָּ֗ה כְּחֶ֣רֶב פִּיֹּֽות׃

verses.ar: قَدَمَاهَا تَنْحَدِرَانِ إِلَى ٱلْمَوْتِ. خَطَوَاتُهَا تَتَمَسَّكُ بِٱلْهَاوِيَةِ.
verses.kjv: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
verses.web: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
verses.he: רַ֭גְלֶיהָ יֹרְדֹ֣ות מָ֑וֶת שְׁ֝אֹ֗ול צְעָדֶ֥יהָ יִתְמֹֽכוּ׃

verses.ar: لِئَلَّا تَتَأَمَّلَ طَرِيقَ ٱلْحَيَاةِ، تَمَايَلَتْ خَطَوَاتُهَا وَلَا تَشْعُرُ.
verses.kjv: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, [that] thou canst not know [them].
verses.web: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.
verses.he: אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים פֶּן־תְּפַלֵּ֑ס נָע֥וּ מַ֝עְגְּלֹתֶ֗יהָ לֹ֣א תֵדֽ͏ָע׃ פ

verses.ar: وَٱلْآنَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْبَنُونَ ٱسْمَعُوا لِي، وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا عَنْ كَلِمَاتِ فَمِي.
verses.kjv: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
verses.web: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.
verses.he: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י וְאַל־תָּ֝ס֗וּרוּ מֵאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃

verses.ar: أَبْعِدْ طَرِيقَكَ عَنْهَا، وَلَا تَقْرَبْ إِلَى بَابِ بَيْتِهَا،
verses.kjv: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
verses.web: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
verses.he: הַרְחֵ֣ק מֵעָלֶ֣יהָ דַרְכֶּ֑ךָ וְאַל־תִּ֝קְרַ֗ב אֶל־פֶּ֥תַח בֵּיתָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: لِئَلَّا تُعْطِيَ زَهْرَكَ لِآخَرِينَ، وَسِنِينَكَ لِلْقَاسِي.
verses.kjv: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:
verses.web: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;
verses.he: פֶּן־תִּתֵּ֣ן לַאֲחֵרִ֣ים הֹודֶ֑ךָ וּ֝שְׁנֹתֶ֗יךָ לְאַכְזָרִֽי׃

verses.ar: لِئَلَّا تَشْبَعَ ٱلْأَجَانِبُ مِنْ قُوَّتِكَ، وَتَكُونَ أَتْعَابُكَ فِي بَيْتِ غَرِيبٍ.
verses.kjv: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours [be] in the house of a stranger;
verses.web: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.
verses.he: פֶּֽן־יִשְׂבְּע֣וּ זָרִ֣ים כֹּחֶ֑ךָ וַ֝עֲצָבֶ֗יךָ בְּבֵ֣ית נָכְרֽ͏ִי׃

verses.ar: فَتَنُوحَ فِي أَوَاخِرِكَ، عِنْدَ فَنَاءِ لَحْمِكَ وَجِسْمِكَ،
verses.kjv: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
verses.web: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,
verses.he: וְנָהַמְתָּ֥ בְאַחֲרִיתֶ֑ךָ בִּכְלֹ֥ות בְּ֝שָׂרְךָ֗ וּשְׁאֵרֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: فَتَقُولَ: «كَيْفَ أَنِّي أَبْغَضْتُ ٱلْأَدَبَ، وَرَذَلَ قَلْبِي ٱلتَّوْبِيخَ!
verses.kjv: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
verses.web: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.
verses.he: וְֽאָמַרְתָּ֗ אֵ֭יךְ שָׂנֵ֣אתִי מוּסָ֑ר וְ֝תֹוכַ֗חַת נָאַ֥ץ לִבִּֽי׃

verses.ar: وَلَمْ أَسْمَعْ لِصَوْتِ مُرْشِدِيَّ، وَلَمْ أَمِلْ أُذُنِي إِلَى مُعَلِّمِيَّ.
verses.kjv: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
verses.web: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!
verses.he: וְֽלֹא־שָׁ֭מַעְתִּי בְּקֹ֣ול מֹורָ֑י וְ֝לִֽמְלַמְּדַ֗י לֹא־הִטִּ֥יתִי אָזְנִֽי׃

verses.ar: لَوْلَا قَلِيلٌ لَكُنْتُ فِي كُلِّ شَرٍّ، فِي وَسَطِ ٱلزُّمْرَةِ وَٱلْجَمَاعَةِ».
verses.kjv: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
verses.web: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”
verses.he: כִּ֭מְעַט הָיִ֣יתִי בְכָל־רָ֑ע בְּתֹ֖וךְ קָהָ֣ל וְעֵדָֽה׃

verses.ar: اِشْرَبْ مِيَاهًا مِنْ جُبِّكَ، وَمِيَاهًا جَارِيَةً مِنْ بِئْرِكَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.
verses.web: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.
verses.he: שְׁתֵה־מַ֥יִם מִבֹּורֶ֑ךָ וְ֝נֹזְלִ֗ים מִתֹּ֥וךְ בְּאֵרֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: لَا تَفِضْ يَنَابِيعُكَ إِلَى ٱلْخَارِجِ، سَوَاقِيَ مِيَاهٍ فِي ٱلشَّوَارِعِ.
verses.kjv: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, [and] rivers of waters in the streets.
verses.web: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?
verses.he: יָפ֣וּצוּ מַעְיְנֹתֶ֣יךָ ח֑וּצָה בָּ֝רְחֹבֹ֗ות פַּלְגֵי־מָֽיִם׃

verses.ar: لِتَكُنْ لَكَ وَحْدَكَ، وَلَيْسَ لِأَجَانِبَ مَعَكَ.
verses.kjv: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers’ with thee.
verses.web: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.
verses.he: יִֽהְיוּ־לְךָ֥ לְבַדֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֖ין לְזָרִ֣ים אִתָּֽךְ׃

verses.ar: لِيَكُنْ يَنْبُوعُكَ مُبَارَكًا، وَٱفْرَحْ بِٱمْرَأَةِ شَبَابِكَ،
verses.kjv: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
verses.web: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
verses.he: יְהִֽי־מְקֹורְךָ֥ בָר֑וּךְ וּ֝שְׂמַ֗ח מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת נְעוּרֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: ٱلظَّبْيَةِ ٱلْمَحْبُوبَةِ وَٱلْوَعْلَةِ ٱلزَّهِيَّةِ. لِيُرْوِكَ ثَدْيَاهَا فِي كُلِّ وَقْتٍ، وَبِمَحَبَّتِهَا ٱسْكَرْ دَائِمًا.
verses.kjv: [Let her be as] the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.
verses.web: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
verses.he: אַיֶּ֥לֶת אֲהָבִ֗ים וְֽיַעֲלַ֫ת־חֵ֥ן דַּ֭דֶּיהָ יְרַוֻּ֣ךָ בְכָל־עֵ֑ת בְּ֝אַהֲבָתָ֗הּ תִּשְׁגֶּ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃

verses.ar: فَلِمَ تُفْتَنُ يَا ٱبْنِي بِأَجْنَبِيَّةٍ، وَتَحْتَضِنُ غَرِيبَةً؟
verses.kjv: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
verses.web: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?
verses.he: וְלָ֤מָּה תִשְׁגֶּ֣ה בְנִ֣י בְזָרָ֑ה וּ֝תְחַבֵּ֗ק חֵ֣ק נָכְרִיָּֽה׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ طُرُقَ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ أَمَامَ عَيْنَيِ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَهُوَ يَزِنُ كُلَّ سُبُلِهِ.
verses.kjv: For the ways of man [are] before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.
verses.web: For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes. He examines all his paths.
verses.he: כִּ֤י נֹ֨כַח ׀ עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה דַּרְכֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְֽכָל־מַעְגְּלֹתָ֥יו מְפַלֵּֽס׃

verses.ar: ٱلشِّرِّيرُ تَأْخُذُهُ آثَامُهُ وَبِحِبَالِ خَطِيَّتِهِ يُمْسَكُ.
verses.kjv: ¶ His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.
verses.web: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
verses.he: עַֽוֹונֹותָ֗יו יִלְכְּדֻנֹ֥ו אֶת־הָרָשָׁ֑ע וּבְחַבְלֵ֥י חַ֝טָּאתֹ֗ו יִתָּמֵֽךְ׃

verses.ar: إِنَّهُ يَمُوتُ مِنْ عَدَمِ ٱلْأَدَبِ، وَبِفَرْطِ حُمْقِهِ يَتَهَوَّرُ.
verses.kjv: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
verses.web: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
verses.he: ה֗וּא יָ֭מוּת בְּאֵ֣ין מוּסָ֑ר וּבְרֹ֖ב אִוַּלְתֹּ֣ו יִשְׁגֶּֽה׃ פ
